evidence.name: Screen field: Lowest number on the wheel
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Lowest number on the wheel" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Lowest number on the wheel
sections.description: The smallest number a Range-mode wheel starts at. Together with the 'to' value it sets the span users can scroll — for example from 1 to 10 lets them pick any number from 1 through 10. Keep this lower than 'to', and set it to the smallest realistic answer for your question, such as a minimum age or quantity.
